div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
│ 1. Primary loses power
│ 2. Application servers cannot connect to 10.0.1.50
│ 3. Writes fail. Application errors propagate to users.
│ 4. Operator manually edits config files to point to 10.0.1.51
│ 5. Operator restarts application servers (rolling restart)
│ 6. Writes resume — after 37 minutes of downtime

Problems: No automatic detection, no automatic failover,
no quorum check, no lease enforcement
